PLANE_X_GIT_REFS.why_no_execution: X-R1 is a governed DN read. PLANE-X's credential class must therefore follow from the COMMAND CONTRACT or be left unresolved.

the_measured_default_that_made_this_nece.finding: This machine HAS a git credential helper configured: git config --get-all credential.helper returns 'manager' (Git Credential Manager).
the_measured_default_that_made_this_nece.consequence: X-R1 as originally contracted — a bare 'git ls-remote origin' — WOULD present a credential via GCM. Its credential class would then be 'a GCM-held credential for github.com' whose scope is not introspectable without reading the credential (prohibited) or a further provider call. PLANE-X would have been UNRESOLVED.
the_measured_default_that_made_this_nece.why_this_was_measured_rather_than_assume: The absence of a helper would have made the credential-free claim trivially true. It is present, so the claim has to be earned by the command form.

NORMATIVE_COMMAND_CONTRACT_ADDENDUM.rule: X-R1 MUST be invoked with git credential helpers reset and terminal prompting disabled. The mandated form is: GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git -c credential.helper= ls-remote <origin-url>
NORMATIVE_COMMAND_CONTRACT_ADDENDUM.relationship_to_the_existing_X-R1_contra: This NARROWS X-R1 and never widens it. Every existing X-R1 requirement is preserved unchanged: the invocation remains UNFILTERED with no refspec (DF-5), the total ref count is still recorded as the non-emptiness witness, the heads and tags limbs are still reported as separate verdicts, and refs are still recorded by full name with full 40-character SHAs.

authoritative_basis.rule: The guarantee is derived from the INSTALLED git 2.54.0.windows.1's OWN documentation on this machine, not from recall.

credential_helper_reset.quoted: helper is configured to the empty string, this resets the helper list to empty (so you may override a helper set by a lower-priority config file by configuring the empty-string helper, followed by whatever set of helpers you would like).

terminal_prompt_suppression.quoted: GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT If this Boolean environment variable is set to false, git will not prompt on the terminal (e.g., when asking for HTTP authentication).

authoritative_basis.corroborating_local_observation: Under the override, git -c credential.helper= config --get-all credential.helper returns the ordered list ['manager', ''] — the empty string appearing LAST, at highest precedence, which is the position the documented reset semantics require in order to clear the helpers configured at lower priority.

NORMATIVE_COMMAND_CONTRACT_ADDENDUM.the_guarantee: With the helper list reset to empty AND terminal prompting disabled, git has no mechanism by which to obtain or present a credential for an HTTPS remote. It cannot silently authenticate.
NORMATIVE_COMMAND_CONTRACT_ADDENDUM.the_fail_closed_property: If the repository were NOT publicly readable, the mandated form FAILS rather than quietly authenticating with an ambient credential. That is strictly safer than the original form: a failure is visible, a silent credentialed success is not. Note that this lane did NOT read the repository's visibility — that is G-R1's job and G-R1 is gated — so the contract is written to be correct under either visibility.

CAPABILITY_VERSUS_AUTHORIZATION_GAP.severity: MEDIUM — INFORMATIONAL BUT LOAD-BEARING FOR THE NEXT GATE
CAPABILITY_VERSUS_AUTHORIZATION_GAP.finding: THE MEASURED CREDENTIALS CAN PERFORM EVERY ACT THE AUTHORITY MOST FIRMLY FORBIDS.
the_measurement: GitHub repo scope confers administration of branch protection and rulesets — the credential that reads protection is the credential that can delete it.
GitHub workflow scope confers the ability to edit .github/workflows/**, which EAD-5 records as requiring an authority that does not exist and which EXPLICIT_NON_AUTHORIZATIONS prohibits outright.

Vercel OWNER confers write on the production branch setting, the Git integration, the Ignored Build Step, environment variables, deployments, aliases and deploy hooks — the whole surface M-6 and M-7 would mutate, and the entire read target of V-R1 through V-R4.
CAPABILITY_VERSUS_AUTHORIZATION_GAP.why_this_is_not_a_defect_to_fix_here: Neither provider offers a read-only credential class that would still permit the nine reads. GitHub's branch-protection read requires admin; Vercel's CLI session is role-based and OWNER is what this principal holds. Narrowing the credential is not available as a control at this layer.
CAPABILITY_VERSUS_AUTHORIZATION_GAP.what_it_means_for_the_next_gate: The separation between reading and mutating rests ENTIRELY on the authority's own controls — RC-1's explicit GET-only verbs, RC-10's refusal of unenumerated operations, and the evidence discipline each read carries. It does NOT rest on any technical incapacity. A certifier should weigh the read controls knowing that nothing outside them prevents a mutation.
CAPABILITY_VERSUS_AUTHORIZATION_GAP.why_it_is_recorded: RC-9a's stated purpose is that the elevated privilege of a read be VISIBLE TO A CERTIFIER rather than a detail of how the read happened to be performed. This block is that visibility, measured rather than assumed.
